notes.title: Stranded With Darkness now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
So the game is avaible for everyone to try.
I added som monster variety before launch. There as still only 2 monster models, but with different colors and abilities. So keep an eye out for the less common ones :)

Im currently working on improving the AI and also some new building pieces/traps.
If you have ideas or questions please reach out!

I hope you all find the playstyle fun. I love base building games and defending like tower defense. But i also love the gathering aspect of a good survival game. So i have tried to put a little from each genre together. 

Enjoy!

/Feather Force Strudio
